seo.title: Ulta Beauty: AI-personalized loyalty - 95% of sales from members (2025)
seo.meta_description: Ulta Beauty personalizes offers and recommendations with AI across its 46.7 million Rewards members, with whom it makes about 95% of its revenue.
seo.resume_citable: About 95% of Ulta Beauty's revenue is made with its 46.7 million Ulta Beauty Rewards members, whose first-party data feeds machine-learning personalization of offers, recommendations, and AI-augmented beauty advice.

faq.q: How much weight do loyal members carry at Ulta Beauty?
faq.a: About 95% of revenue is made with Ulta Beauty Rewards members, a program with 46.7 million active members at the close of fiscal 2025.

faq.q: How does Ulta use AI for loyalty?
faq.a: It draws on members' first-party data through machine learning to personalize offers and recommendations, reactivate inactives through retargeting, and tie the loyalty identifier to its Skin Advisor for routines based on history and stock.

pattern: AI personalization of offers and product recommendations on loyalty data
objectif_business: Retain a member base that drives most of the revenue by pushing each member the recommendations and offers matching their purchases, and reactivating customers who drop off before they leave.
description: The Ulta Beauty Rewards program has 46.7 million active members at the close of fiscal 2025, and about 95% of revenue is made with them. Ulta unifies these members' first-party data (purchase history, browsing, preferences, phone number as cross-channel identifier) into profiles used by machine learning to personalize product recommendations, emails, and offers. The retailer retargets members who have become inactive through paid advertising. On the more recent AI layer, Ulta integrated loyalty identifiers into its Skin Advisor interface to propose skincare routines based on purchase history and real-time stock, and is testing a virtual beauty advisor. Kelly Mahoney sums up the setup's raw material when she calls data the company's crown jewel.

resultats.metrique: Share of revenue from loyalty program members (fiscal 2025)
Loyalty program growth between 2022 and February 2025
Active program members, up 5% year over year (fiscal 2025)

niveau_preuve.justification: Ulta itself puts figures on the foundation of the case in its financial results. The fiscal 2025 10-K, filed with the SEC on March 26, 2026, reports about 95% of sales coming from members and more than 46 million members at the close, and explicitly ties that base to personalization through its CRM (S4). The earnings call of March 12, 2026 gives the count of 46.7 million active members, up 5% year over year (S5). The three press sources (S1 to S3) remain the layer that documents the use of AI on that data. Beware of a widespread confusion in the trade press: these 95% are the share of revenue made with members, not a customer repeat-purchase rate.

stack_technique.detail: Members' first-party Rewards data (purchase history, browsing, preferences) unified with the phone number as cross-channel identifier.
Scoring and personalization of product recommendations, emails, and offers; exact models not disclosed.
Skincare advice interface tied to the loyalty identifier: routines proposed from purchase history and real-time stock.
Paid reactivation of members who have become inactive; platforms not publicly named.

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: Near real time: messages and recommendations updated as the member acts, reactivation campaigns by wave
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: Ulta's customer and growth marketing team, supported by the data and product teams
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: Purchase and browsing history tied to the loyalty profile, with the phone number as cross-channel key. Without that linkage, the member becomes anonymous again and the recommendation loses its basis.

etapes.detail: Purchase history, browsing, preferences, and contact details are centralized into a single profile.
Machine learning ranks for each member the products and offers to feature.
Emails, in-app offers, and product recommendations are pushed to the member, updated near real time.
Members who drop off are retargeted through paid advertising before they slip into loss.
Skin Advisor ties in the loyalty identifier to propose routines based on history and real-time stock.

prerequis_data: a loyalty program with high penetration
prerequis_orga: an equipped growth and CRM team
paid retargeting capability on the loyalty base
stack_possible: an email and in-app orchestration platform
a conversational AI component for advice
replication.premiere_etape: Unify members' purchase and browsing data into a usable profile, with a stable cross-channel identifier.

playbook.action: Unify members' purchases, browsing, and preferences into a single profile, with a stable cross-channel identifier (the phone at Ulta).
Put scoring and recommendation in place, personalize emails and in-app offers with a control group.
playbook.livrable: First personalized campaigns measured against control.

playbook.action: Build reactivation audiences for inactive members and connect them to paid retargeting.
playbook.livrable: A reactivation loop in production with a cost per reactivated member.

playbook.action: Add the advice component (routines based on history and stock) and read the overall retention impact.
playbook.livrable: An advice assistant in pilot and an annual retention review.

replication.equipe: 1 growth/CRM PM + 2 data scientists or engineers + 1 lifecycle marketer + 1 paid media contact.

statut_vivant.note: AI personalization anchored to the loyalty program is presented as a growth pillar in the quarterly results through 2026, with a goal of extending the member base toward 50 million by 2028.

transposable_ue.note: Personalization relies on loyalty members' first-party data (purchase history, browsing, phone as cross-channel identifier). In the EU, GDPR consent is required for this profiling and for using the phone number as a targeting key. An AI beauty advisor stays outside high risk under the AI Act as long as it does not make a decision with legal effect.
